requested_libraries.description: Software the user EXPLICITLY named and asked to be used, e.g. 'compute it with GPAW', 'use pymatgen', 'run this in VASP'. Record the name exactly as the user wrote it, one entry per tool, ordered as they mentioned them. Include codes, packages, and calculators alike -- whether or not you believe they are installed; TWAIN checks availability itself and files an install request when something is missing. Emit an empty array (or omit) when the user named no software: never guess or fill in the tool you would pick yourself, since that would look like a user request.

system_descriptors.description: Identifies the physical system. Pick the representation that matches the system TYPE, then fill in that ONE sub-object: a discrete, finite molecule uses `molecule` (a SMILES string); a periodic solid -- a crystal, bulk metal / semiconductor / oxide, or a surface / slab of one -- uses `crystal`. SMILES cannot represent a periodic solid, so NEVER invent a SMILES for a crystal; describe it by formula + polymorph/phase (and a structure source when known) instead.

kind.description: Which representation this spec uses. 'molecule' for a discrete molecule; 'crystal' for a periodic bulk solid; 'surface' for a slab / surface of a solid (also described under `crystal`).

molecule.description: ONLY when kind='molecule': a discrete, finite molecule identified by its SMILES. Omit entirely for periodic solids.

crystal.description: ONLY when kind='crystal' or kind='surface': a periodic solid. Identify the polymorph/phase whenever the composition has more than one (e.g. rutile vs anatase vs brookite TiO2) -- different polymorphs have different properties. Pin the structure when you can: a Materials Project id (mp_id), an inline/path CIF, or a space group (+ crystal system). No SMILES.

formula.description: Chemical formula of the solid, e.g. 'TiO2'.

cif.description: CIF structure as inline text or a file path.

formula.description: Chemical formula of the system, e.g. 'TiO2' or 'C2H4O2'.

target_value.description: null means the researcher gave no number to hit -- judge against a reference instead. Prefer null over a 0.0 placeholder, which downstream stages compare against literally.

tolerance.description: null when target_value is null: there is no band to be inside of.

metadata.description: [0,1] confidence levels. Emit ONLY the confidence scores relevant to the chosen representation -- for a molecule that is SMILES_confidence / name_confidence; for a crystal/surface it is formula_confidence / phase_confidence / structure_confidence. Always include objective_confidence and domain_confidence. Do NOT emit a low SMILES_confidence for a solid: a solid has no SMILES, so the field does not apply.

phase_confidence.description: Confidence that the polymorph/phase of a crystal is correctly identified.

structure_confidence.description: Confidence in the crystal structure source (mp_id / CIF / space group).
